name: Seeds Layouts
description: Framework-agnostic Layout Builder layouts (one/two/three column) with per-section responsive column widths, configurable custom fields (class select/checkbox, background image, wrappers, hide-if-empty), free-text attributes, CSS-framework presets, and heavy Layout Builder / Media Library theming.

suggests.drupal/layout_builder_restrictions: Enables the 'Restrict Block Choose' restriction plugin and the 'access all blocks layouts' permission gate.
suggests.drupal/classes_extractor: Required by the seeds_layouts_classes_extractor submodule to expose Seeds Layouts classes to CSS build/purge tools.

project_description: Seeds Layouts provides Layout Builder section layouts (one, two and three columns) that are written to work with any CSS framework instead of hard-coding one grid. Each section's configuration form is reorganised into Layout / Field / Advanced tabs: editors pick responsive column widths per breakpoint (desktop/tablet/mobile) from framework-specific presets, toggle a container/full-width wrapper and reverse column order, add configurable 'layout fields' (a class chosen from a select list, a class toggled by a checkbox, a background image with parallax/repeat, region wrappers, hide-section-if-empty, and an alpha React blocks-grouping wrapper), and set free-text attribute strings on the section, columns parent and each region. A CSS framework's column presets are loaded through an admin 'Import a Framework' form (Bootstrap 3/4, Foundation, Tailwind CSS presets ship in-module) which writes into seeds_layouts.config and seeds_layouts.columns. The module also re-themes many Layout Builder, form and Media Library templates (via '--seeds-lb' template suggestions and libraries-extend) to give a more end-user-oriented building experience, adds preview images to the block/section browser via an image_path third-party setting, and can restrict which blocks non-privileged editors may place. The seeds_layouts_classes_extractor submodule integrates with the classes_extractor module so the classes stored in Seeds Layouts config are discoverable by utility-CSS build/purge tools. Part of the Seeds toolkit; sponsored and developed by Sprintive.
